ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.14 replaces V0.4.13's per-IList position snapshots with a persistent per-map search fabric. Repeated IList-backed custom GenClosest sources cache only membership/order on the main thread; positions are maintained incrementally from ThingGrid events and worker cores publish immutable bucket views. Movement no longer forces a full source-position rebuild. To protect smoothness, any query predicted to require more than 64 live Reachability/validator checks bypasses RimMT before expensive work and runs Vanilla directly. Mobile Pawn-backed or unspawned source sets remain fail-closed. Live Reachability.CanReach, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Exact ListerHaulables searches still use the dedicated V0.4.6/V0.4.7 accelerators. Bounded path shadow validation, V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained. Performance priority: visible stutter first, stability second, TPS third.
